Orbyte Policy Center
These policies are built directly into Orbyte, so they are always easy to find from Settings and Account Standing.

Terms of Service

Orbyte policies

Terms of Service

These Terms are the agreement between you and the operator of Orbyte. They explain who may use the service, what you may do, how your content is handled, and what can happen when the rules are broken.

● Effective August 30, 2026 · Version 2026-08-30-r3
You must actively accept these Terms and the Community Guidelines. New accounts cannot be created without acceptance. Existing accounts may be asked to accept an updated version before continuing to use Orbyte.

1. Eligibility, birthday, and teen accounts

You must be at least 13 years old to create or use an Orbyte account. You may not provide a false birthday or help someone below the minimum age access Orbyte. If Orbyte reasonably determines that an account belongs to someone under 13, the account may be disabled until the user becomes eligible. The user can appeal the decision. When an email is attached, Orbyte may keep it for up to 90 days only to send the restriction notice, provide restricted recovery access, and let the user replace it with a verified parent or guardian email or remove it. If no action is taken, the email is removed automatically.

2. Your account

You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your password and sign-in details secure. Do not sell, transfer, share, or automate access to an account in a way that creates abuse or avoids enforcement. You must not impersonate Orbyte, staff, another person, or another service in a misleading way.

3. Acceptable use

You must follow the Community Guidelines. You may not use Orbyte for harassment, threats, scams, phishing, malware, account theft, privacy violations, exploitation, coordinated abuse, enforcement evasion, or unlawful activity. Attempts to break, overload, scrape, reverse engineer, or bypass security and rate limits are also prohibited unless Orbyte has explicitly authorized the testing.

4. Your content and permission to operate the service

You keep ownership of content you create. You grant Orbyte a limited, non-exclusive permission to host, store, process, resize, reproduce, display, and deliver that content only as needed to operate, secure, moderate, back up, and improve the service. You confirm that you have the rights and permissions needed to upload or share the content.

5. Servers, channels, bots, and communities

Server owners, moderators, bot developers, and webhook owners are responsible for how they configure and operate their communities and integrations. Orbyte may remove content, disable invites or integrations, reset misleading information, restrict a server, remove a server, or act against responsible accounts when a community or integration is used for abuse, scams, or rule evasion.

6. Moderation, evidence, and appeals

Orbyte may review reports, messages, attachments, account information, server activity, and other relevant evidence to investigate possible violations. Enforcement may include warnings, content removal, feature limits, server action, temporary suspension, or permanent suspension. Decisions consider context, severity, intent, history, and risk of harm. Eligible decisions may be appealed through Account Standing.

7. Orbyte Plus, paid features, trials, and gifts

Orbyte Plus is an optional paid account upgrade. Core messaging and community access remain available without Plus, while Plus may provide higher upload limits, additional customization such as custom multi-color themes and profile backgrounds, subscriber badges, Diamonds, call customization, or other benefits shown in the Plus feature chart. The exact benefits, limits, price, duration, and whether a checkout is one-time or recurring are the terms shown to you before purchase.

Payments may be processed by a third-party checkout or payment provider. You are responsible for providing accurate payment information and for any taxes or fees disclosed at checkout. Trials, promotional codes, gifts, and purchased gift codes may have eligibility rules, expiration dates, or redemption limits. They may not be resold, exchanged for cash, duplicated, or obtained through fraud, chargebacks, payment abuse, or technical exploits. Orbyte may revoke improperly obtained Plus access or virtual rewards. A 7-day Plus pass may also be offered for 10 Diamonds while Plus is inactive. A 7-day Plus gift may also be purchased for 10 Diamonds and shared as a single-use gift code. Diamond-funded Plus passes and gifts do not include the 50-Diamond monthly subscription reward and do not automatically renew. Refund rights are determined by applicable law and any terms presented at checkout; nothing in these Terms removes mandatory consumer rights.

When Plus expires, Plus-only features may become unavailable. Orbyte may preserve associated settings, such as a custom profile background, so they can become available again if Plus is reactivated, but Orbyte does not guarantee permanent storage of Plus-only customization. Plus benefits may evolve over time; material changes will be communicated where reasonably practical.

8. Diamonds and virtual items

Diamonds and virtual items are service features, not money, stored value, or property. They cannot be sold, transferred for cash, or redeemed outside Orbyte. Orbyte may correct balances obtained through errors, abuse, fraud, chargebacks, or manipulation and may change rewards or availability with reasonable notice.

9. Service availability and changes

Orbyte is provided as available. Features may change, pause, or stop, and the service may experience bugs, interruptions, security incidents, or data loss. Keep independent copies of anything important. Orbyte does not guarantee that every feature, message, attachment, or account will always remain available.

10. Ending access

You may stop using Orbyte at any time. Orbyte may restrict or terminate access when reasonably necessary to enforce these Terms, protect users or the service, comply with law, prevent abuse, or respond to security risks. Where practical and safe, Account Standing will explain the action and whether an appeal is available.

11. Disclaimers and responsibility

To the maximum extent allowed by applicable law, Orbyte is provided without warranties that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or suitable for every purpose. Orbyte is not responsible for content, conduct, purchases, promises, or external links supplied by other users, servers, bots, or third parties. Nothing in these Terms removes rights that cannot legally be waived.

12. Updates to these Terms

Important changes will be announced in the app. When a new version requires acceptance, Orbyte will block normal use until you review and accept it. The version and acceptance time may be recorded on your account.

13. Questions and support

Questions about these Terms, enforcement, or account access can be sent through the Orbyte Support Center. Reports and appeals must be honest and must not be used to harass or punish another person.

Orbyte policies

Community Guidelines

Be decent to people, protect others from scams and harm, and use common sense. These guidelines are intentionally clear without being unnecessarily strict.

● Effective July 26, 2026
Respect people

Do not harass, threaten, stalk, or target people because of who they are.

Keep accounts safe

No phishing, malware, token grabbers, scams, or fake login pages.

Protect privacy

Do not expose private information or intimate content without permission.

Run servers responsibly

Do not build communities mainly for abuse, scams, impersonation, or evasion.

Treat people fairly

  • Do not attack, exclude, or judge people because of gender, age, skin color, nationality, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or similar personal traits.
  • Do not repeatedly harass, threaten, stalk, humiliate, or encourage others to target someone.
  • Normal disagreement, criticism, jokes, and isolated mistakes are not automatically violations. Context matters.

Do not scam or compromise accounts

  • Do not send phishing links, malware, token grabbers, fake verification pages, fake giveaways, or deceptive downloads.
  • Do not request passwords, authentication codes, session tokens, or other secrets.
  • Do not impersonate Orbyte, Discord, staff, or another person to mislead people.

Protect privacy and safety

  • Do not share another person's private information without permission.
  • Do not threaten serious harm, promote exploitation, or coordinate clearly illegal activity.
  • Do not use Orbyte to evade a valid safety action on another account or server.

Use servers responsibly

  • Do not create or operate servers mainly for scams, harassment, impersonation, or enforcement evasion.
  • Server owners and moderators should respond reasonably to harmful behavior and keep invite links under control.
  • Reports should be honest. Do not knowingly submit false reports to punish someone you dislike.

How enforcement works

Actions can range from content removal and warnings to feature limits, server changes, suspension, or bans. We look at severity, intent, repetition, account history, and whether someone tried to fix the problem. Good-faith mistakes are treated differently from deliberate abuse.

Orbyte policies

Privacy Policy

This policy explains what information Orbyte handles, why it is used, when it may be shared, how long it may be kept, and the choices available to you.

● Effective August 9, 2026 · Version 2026-08-09
Privacy controls are built into Orbyte. You can review account standing, privacy preferences, blocked users, reports, appeals, and account controls from Settings. Contact the Support Center for privacy requests that cannot be completed in the app.

1. Who this policy covers

This Privacy Policy applies to the Orbyte website, desktop and mobile clients, servers, direct messages, calls, social features, bots, developer tools, support tools, and other Orbyte features that link to this policy. It does not govern independent websites, bots, payment services, wallet software, or integrations operated by third parties.

2. Information Orbyte may collect

  • Account and profile information: username, display name, password hash, email when supplied, avatar, banner, biography, connections, preferences, account creation date, and account status.
  • Age and eligibility information: birthday-derived age group, minimum-age eligibility dates, age appeals, and related safety evidence. Orbyte is intended for users aged 13 or older.
  • Content and communications: messages, posts, stories, voice messages, files, reactions, reports, appeals, support requests, server content, and information you choose to share in calls or profiles.
  • Servers and social activity: server memberships, roles, channels, friendships, blocks, invites, moderation actions, bot installations, commands, and interaction history needed to provide the service.
  • Device, security, and usage information: IP address, device and browser information, app version, language, approximate region inferred from network data, login sessions, security events, crash information, request logs, and feature usage needed to operate, protect, and troubleshoot Orbyte.
  • Safety and moderation information: reports, surrounding context, evidence, account-standing records, enforcement decisions, server actions, administrator notes, and appeal history.
  • Donation interactions: Orbyte may record that you opened or copied a donation address, but cryptocurrency transfers occur through the relevant blockchain and wallet providers. Orbyte does not collect card or bank details through the in-app donation page.

3. How information is used

Orbyte uses information to create and secure accounts; deliver messages, calls, files, servers, profiles, notifications, and social features; synchronize devices; personalize settings; provide support; operate bots and authorized integrations; prevent spam, fraud, abuse, and account compromise; investigate reports; enforce the Terms and Community Guidelines; maintain reliability; diagnose bugs; and meet legal obligations.

Depending on the feature and applicable law, processing may be necessary to provide the service you requested, protect users and Orbyte, comply with legal obligations, or act with your consent where consent is required.

4. Public and shared information

Information you post in public or shared spaces can be seen by the people who have access to those spaces. Server owners and moderators may manage their communities and review content available to them. People may copy or reshare content they can access. Review a server's audience and your privacy settings before sharing sensitive information.

5. When information may be shared

  • With other users: to deliver the content, profile information, presence, server activity, and interactions you choose to share.
  • With authorized bots and integrations: only according to the permissions you or a server administrator grant. Removing an authorization stops future access through Orbyte but may not delete information already received by the third party.
  • With service providers: hosting, storage, email delivery, security, error monitoring, and other infrastructure providers that process information to help operate Orbyte.
  • For safety or legal reasons: when reasonably necessary to investigate abuse, protect people or the service, respond to valid legal process, enforce policies, or prevent fraud and security incidents.
  • During a project transfer: if Orbyte is reorganized, transferred, or acquired, information may move with the service subject to appropriate notice and safeguards.

Orbyte does not sell personal information. Orbyte does not use the donation page to sell features or unlock account privileges.

6. Data retention

Information is kept only for as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described in this policy. Retention depends on the type of information, whether the account remains active, safety and security needs, ongoing appeals or disputes, legal requirements, and whether the information also forms part of another user's conversation or server history.

When an account is deleted or no longer needs to remain identifiable, Orbyte may delete information or disconnect it from the account. Some messages may remain in shared conversations with identifying account details removed where appropriate. Safety evidence, audit records, and enforcement history may be kept longer when necessary to protect users, prevent repeated abuse, resolve appeals, or comply with law.

For an account disabled because it does not meet the minimum age, an attached email may be kept for up to 90 days for the restriction notice, restricted recovery, appeal updates, and the choice to replace or remove it. It is removed sooner when the user requests removal or a verified guardian contact replaces it.

7. Your choices and controls

  • Edit profile information and privacy preferences in Settings.
  • Block users and control message-request preferences.
  • Review Account Standing, reports, enforcement details, and eligible appeals.
  • Remove authorized bots and integrations or change their permissions.
  • Request access, correction, export, restriction, objection, or deletion where applicable by using in-app controls or contacting the Support Center.
  • Delete content where the feature provides a delete control. Copies may remain temporarily in backups, safety records, or content previously copied by others.

8. Children and minimum age

You must be at least 13 years old to create or use an Orbyte account. If Orbyte reasonably determines that an account belongs to someone below the minimum age, access may be disabled while preserving a way to appeal. Orbyte limits the processing of restricted accounts and follows the retention process described above.

9. Security

Orbyte uses technical and organizational measures intended to protect accounts and information, including hashed passwords, session controls, permission checks, access restrictions, audit records, and abuse monitoring. No service can guarantee absolute security. Use a unique password, protect login links and codes, review authorized apps, and report suspected account compromise promptly.

10. International processing

Orbyte and its infrastructure providers may process information in more than one country. Where required, Orbyte will use appropriate safeguards for international transfers and will continue to protect information under this policy.

11. Changes to this policy

Orbyte may update this Privacy Policy as features, practices, or legal requirements change. Material updates will be announced in the app or through another appropriate channel. The effective date and version shown above identify the current policy.

12. Contact

Privacy questions and requests can be submitted through Settings → Support Center. Before a public launch, the Orbyte operator should ensure that its legal name, business address, privacy contact, and any required representative or data-protection contact are accurately published.
